headline: Fractional CMO Cost: 2026 Pricing Breakdown
image: [IMAGE: Fractional CMO cost breakdown infographic showing pricing ranges by engagement model]
description: Fractional CMOs cost $3,000-$15,000/month. See rate breakdowns by experience, scope, and engagement model to set the right budget.

mainEntity.name: How much does a fractional CMO cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most fractional CMOs charge between $3,000 and $15,000 per month on a retainer basis. The exact price depends on their experience level, the scope of work, and how many hours per week they dedicate to your business. Series A companies typically spend $5,000-$10,000/month.

mainEntity.name: Is a fractional CMO cheaper than a marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional CMO often costs less than a full-service agency while delivering more senior-level attention. Agencies typically charge $5,000-$25,000/month but assign junior staff to execution. A fractional CMO at $7,000-$10,000/month gives you a dedicated senior leader working directly on your business.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a fractional CMO and a marketing consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: A marketing consultant advises. A fractional CMO leads. Consultants deliver recommendations and leave implementation to you. Fractional CMOs own the marketing strategy, manage your team and vendors, set KPIs, and drive execution. Consultants charge $2,000-$5,000/month; fractional CMOs charge $3,000-$15,000/month for the added accountability.

mainEntity.name: How many hours per week does a fractional CMO work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most fractional CMOs commit 10 to 20 hours per week per client. Lighter advisory engagements may be 5-10 hours. Heavier engagements with team management and hands-on execution can reach 20-25 hours. The hours should match the scope of work defined at the start of the engagement.

mainEntity.name: When should I upgrade from a fractional CMO to a full-time CMO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider hiring a full-time CMO when your fractional engagement consistently exceeds $12,000-$15,000/month for six or more months, your marketing team grows past 10 people, or you need a dedicated C-suite leader for board meetings and investor relations. Until then, fractional leadership typically delivers better value per dollar.
